entities.name: Byrke
entities.description: Legendary black-furred rabbitfolk soldier of Bloomburrow, constable of Fountainport, the Long Ear of the Law.

entities.name: Bria
entities.description: Otterfolk who evades Byrke and costs him his sleep.

events.summary: Byrke rounds up a graffiti ring writing nasty notes outside the pie shop by the docks.
events.quote: The constable once rounded up a graffiti ring

events.summary: Once Bria emerges, Byrke chases her but she always escapes.
events.quote: Though she always manages to get away, he's always right on her tail

relations.quote: diligent constable in service to the great King Glarb himself
he's always right on her tail
